claim_text: Images authentically showed U.S. President Donald Trump viewing a large printout about the demolition of the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts.
query: Images authentically showed U.S. President Donald Trump viewing a large printout about
summary: For example, the Instagram page Occupy Democrats posted images of Trump and the printout, writing, "BREAKING: A sharp-eyed photographer unearths Trump's plan to DESTROY the Kennedy Center – catching him staring at a placard that says 'Kennedy Center Demolished' through the window of his plane!" The images and claims about what they showed also circulated on Facebook (archived), Threads (archived), X (archived), Bluesky (archived) and Reddit (archived). The Kennedy Center takeover is one of several projects aimed at stamping Trump’s brand on the US capital, including lavish gold trim in the Oval Office, a triumphal arch near the National Mall, and a half-billion dollar ballroom at the White House.
